title: SEVEN THINGS
topic: God says He hates 7 things, and number 7 surprises almost everyone (Proverbs 6:16-19)

cover.image: giant cracked stone 7 in the desert
cover.title: GOD HATES 7 THINGS
cover.subtitle: #7 SURPRISES EVERYONE

kjv.PROVERBS 6:16: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
kjv.PROVERBS 6:17: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,
kjv.PROVERBS 6:18: An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations, feet that be swift in running to mischief,
kjv.PROVERBS 6:19: A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.
kjv.ROMANS 5:8: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
kjv.1 JOHN 1:9: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
kjv.MATTHEW 5:9 (caption only): Blessed are the peacemakers: for they shall be called the children of God.

beats.tts: God says He hates seven things.
beats.camera: high wide over the desert; the stone 7 hangs at the top (anticipation), drops, slams; 6-frame shake; slow push-in

tracker.note: hook title GOD HATES 7 THINGS punches in on impact (0-1.8 s), then flies into the caption spot

beats.tts: And number seven surprises almost everyone.
beats.camera: crane down and around the cracked 7 while dust settles; palms still swaying back

tracker.build: tiles 1-7 drop in one by one; tile 7 is a shaking, glowing ?

beats.text: "These six things doth the LORD *hate*: yea, *seven* are an abomination unto him."
beats.tts: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him.
beats.camera: 3D scroll unrolls toward the lens; camera glides along it through a dusty light beam

card.style: scroll (HTML text tracked onto the 3D parchment)
card.text: These six things doth the LORD hate: yea, *SEVEN* are an abomination unto him:

beats.camera: medium tracking shot; rich man in purple and gold walks past a beggar, chin high; his shadow grows huge, the beggar's shrinks

beats.text: Before murder… before lies… *pride* is listed first.
beats.tts: Before murder… before lies… pride is listed first.
beats.camera: slow crane up so the giant shadow fills the frame; beggar small in the corner

beats.text: Number 2: "A *lying* tongue." Yes… even the small ones.
beats.tts: Number two: | A lying tongue. | Yes… even the small ones.
beats.camera: market stall; rack focus from the smiling seller to his shadow on the wall swapping good fruit for rotten

beats.tts: Number three: | Hands that shed innocent blood.
beats.camera: very wide, high, still: two brothers in a field at dusk; one walks away alone; a single red flower bends and wilts (no violence shown)

beats.text: Number 4: "An heart that deviseth *wicked* imaginations." Sin starts in the *mind*.
beats.tts: Number four: | An heart that deviseth wicked imaginations. | Sin starts in the mind.
beats.camera: calm man on a bench; slow push-through into his head: a small dark storm cloud with tiny lightning swirls inside a glowing outline

beats.text: Number 5: "Feet that be swift in running to *mischief*." Running toward trouble.
beats.tts: Number five: | Feet that be swift in running to mischief. | Running toward trouble.
beats.camera: fast low tracking shot alongside a sprinting man heading for a shouting crowd; dust kicks, robe flaps; motion blur

beats.text: Number 6: "A *false witness* that speaketh lies." Ruining someone's *name*.
beats.tts: Number six: | A false witness that speaketh lies. | Ruining someone's name.
beats.camera: city gate, elders on stone seats; the accuser pulls back, then points; push-in on the innocent man as his name tag cracks

labels.anchor: innocent man (name tag cracks in two)
labels.note: a real false-witness case at a city gate, 1 Kings 21:13

sfx: stone crack on the name tag

beats.text: And number 7… the one He saved for *last*:
beats.tts: And number seven… the one He saved for last:
beats.camera: slow dolly-zoom on a quiet village at night; the ? tile shakes harder

beats.tts: He that soweth discord among brethren.
beats.camera: hard hit: tracker ? bursts into a gold 7 with a short shake; cut to friends around a fire joined by thin glowing gold threads
sfx: deep hit + bright shimmer on the reveal

beats.text: Gossip. Stirring drama. Turning friends against each *other*.
beats.tts: Gossip. | Stirring drama. | Turning friends against each other.
beats.camera: slow orbit; one man leans in and whispers ear to ear; each time a gold thread SNAPS; people turn their backs; the circle splits in two

beats.text: Most of us *never* think of that as sin.
beats.tts: Most of us never think of that as sin.
beats.camera: stylized cut: the whispers become a generic phone chat (no app names): "did you hear what she…", "don't tell anyone but…"

beats.text: Be honest… how many did *you* do this week?
beats.tts: Be honest… how many did you do this week?
beats.camera: all 7 tiles big in the middle; they pulse one by one like a self-check; slow push toward the viewer

beats.text: But here's the good news: "God commendeth his *love* toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, *Christ* died for us."
beats.tts: But here's the good news: | God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
beats.camera: slow warm dissolve from cold grey to gold; a soft beam of light falls on a cross on a hill; gentle crane up

card.style: floating cream card over darkened scene
card.text: …God commendeth his *LOVE* toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, *CHRIST* died for us.

beats.text: "If we *confess* our sins, he is faithful and just to *forgive* us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness."
beats.tts: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
beats.camera: the 7 tiles are washed white by light one by one; cut back to the village: snapped threads regrow, the two groups turn and come together around the fire

beats.text: So which one is hardest for you? Just comment the *number*.
beats.tts: So which one is hardest for you? | Just comment the number.
beats.camera: dark warm background, 7 number tiles in a row; a comment box types "7… 😔"; small hearts float up
end card: logo + GRACE IN MOTION + @grace_in_motion616 with a gold shimmer; last frames flow back into the stone 7 falling (loop)
